title: Cross-League Translation: Which Overseas Performances Matter for Gujarat Titans?
dek: Which overseas performances should Gujarat Titans trust? Without other leagues' data, the next-best test is how well an overseas batter's first IPL season predicts the rest of his IPL career.
excerpt: Among overseas batters, debut-season form in the IPL correlates with later form only moderately. It is a real signal, but a noisy one, which is the core problem of cross-league scouting.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: The Translation Problem
body: Scouts watch overseas players in the Big Bash, the SA20, the Caribbean Premier League and international cricket. The question is how much of that form carries into the IPL.
The CricField warehouse holds IPL data only, so it cannot test other leagues directly. It can test the next step: how well a first IPL season predicts what follows.

sections.heading: Debut Versus Later
body: For {{ev:cl-n}} overseas batters with at least sixty balls in their debut season and later, relative strike rates in the two periods correlate at {{ev:cl-r}}.
On average they scored at {{ev:cl-d}} in their debut season and {{ev:cl-l}} afterwards, on a scale where the season average is one hundred. The chart plots each batter.

sections.heading: What It Means for Scouting
body: If even IPL form only partly predicts IPL form, form in another league will predict it less. Scouts should treat a strong overseas record as a prior to be updated quickly, not a guarantee.

sections.heading: Caveats
body: Players who fail in their debut season often get few later chances, which removes them from the comparison. Nationality comes from player-bio data and squad lists, which contain known errors.
{{ev:cl-mine}} of the batters analysed debuted for GT, too few to judge the franchise's own record.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Trust Form, but Update Fast
body: Gujarat Titans should use overseas form as a starting estimate and revise it quickly with IPL evidence.
Adding other leagues' ball-by-ball data would allow a direct translation model.
